overview.description: The Principal Real Estate Active Opportunities ETF (BYRE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund is an actively managed, non-transparent fund that seeks total return by centering on US-listed companies in the real estate industry, selected using a bottom-up fundamental approach. The fund utilizes the Fidelity non-transparent model. BYRE was launched on May 18, 2022 and is issued by Principal.
